description: Customize your internal world you are the only person that lives there #selflove #selfcare
transcript: I live a calm and peaceful life because I'm solid. I do not waver. I make decisions and I stand on them. My internal world is customized and created for every version of me and that is something that I keep to myself. My internal world is not a welcoming place for the external world. The internal world is something that is created for me.
